matt: Quick sync: small proposal to 'prune' one shared helper in session-sidecar and fold it into a tenant-facing helper process. Aim is reduced coupling and fewer GC spikes. Thoughts?

rebecca: short summary pls

matt: Move the "request-prefetcher" out of the monolith. New shape: per-tenant prefetch helper (co-located) + slim session-core. Prefetcher owns warmup keys, rate-limits, and reporting.

own: Perf concerns? extra hop?

matt: Cold path adds ~1ms. Under load we avoid global lock contention and stop big stop-the-world GC pauses. Expect tail improvements. We'll measure with replay.

rebecca: Migration plan?

matt: Phases: (1) Feature-flagged prefetcher in shadow mode; (2) route reads to prefetcher for cohort; (3) switch writes; (4) deprecate old code. Each phase gated by p95, error rate, and cache hit delta.

own: Observability?

matt: Prefetcher emits prefetch_latency, prefetch_success_rate, mem_usage, and tenant_tag. Add short-lived dashboards for rollout.

arch-bot: /cohort create garden-prune-1 -> id gp-177654

rebecca: Ops surface: knobs?

matt: Minimal: prefetch_budget, prefetch_workers, and log_level. Defaults safe. We plan soft-alerts before hard limits.

own: Are there consistency edge cases?

matt: Only for near-real-time keys; we'll add a read-verify step during cutover and short fencing TTLs. Cross-tenant joins stay in session-core.

rebecca: Tests & canary?

matt: Staging replay + chaos. Canary: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 24h holds at 10%. Rollback if p95 > +10% or errors > +1% abs.

own: Who drafts RFC?

matt: I'll draft RFC and attach perf baselines. Rebecca to add cost/ops note, Owen to own staging runs.

rebecca: Action items:
- matt: RFC draft by Thu EOD
- owen: staging replay harness by Wed
- matt: baseline perf run and post numbers in this thread

arch-bot: cohort gp-177654 scheduled for canary at 03:00 UTC tomorrow

matt: Thanks all — keeping this small and iterative. Will post RFC link soon. :seedling:
